title: Zoetrope — Pixel Sprite Studio
description: Draw pixel sprites frame by frame, onion-skin them, and export a real animated GIF encoded in the page.
concept: A complete little animation studio for pixel art. Seven drawing tools work on an indexed-colour canvas from 16x16 up to 64x64, frames are managed on a filmstrip with onion skin and per-frame holds, and playback runs live in a preview pane. The export path is the point: a hand-written GIF89a encoder with its own LZW compressor turns the frame stack into a looping, transparent animated GIF in the browser, alongside a spritesheet PNG and a re-importable project JSON.
features: Seven tools: pencil, eraser, line, rectangle, ellipse, flood fill and eyedropper, with shift for filled shapes and mirror drawing
Frame timeline: add, duplicate, delete, reorder, per-frame hold, onion skin of the previous and next frame
Five palettes plus custom colours, with index clamping and nearest-neighbour resampling on canvas resize
Four procedural starter sprites (slime hop, coin spin, torch flicker, orbit pulse) so the studio is animating on arrival
Export animated GIF (GIF89a + LZW written in-page, transparent index, per-frame delays), spritesheet PNG and project JSON; JSON re-imports
Undo/redo history, keyboard shortcuts and localStorage autosave

interaction.mouse: Drag on the canvas to draw; right-click or Alt-drag erases; hold Shift for filled rectangles and ellipses
interaction.click: Pick tools from the left rail, colours from the palette, frames from the filmstrip; export buttons download GIF, PNG or JSON
interaction.touch: Tap and drag paints on the pixel grid; the layout stacks to a single column on phones
interaction.keyboard: B/E/L/R/O/G/I pick tools, comma and period step frames, Space plays, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo
